```{r data_loading, echo=FALSE}
# Load raw data from Excel
df_raw <- read_excel("bayesian_selectv1.xlsx", sheet = 1)

# Select 17 predictors + 1 target
# Rename to short forms for readability
df <- df_raw %>%
  select(
    MPI_perc,
    Hhsize, Rural_perc, Female_pop, Pop_district, Landsize,
    Num_JHS, Num_Hosp, Num_Police, Num_Bank,
    Dist_JHS, Dist_Hospitals, Dist_Police, Dist_Banking,
    Conc_JHS, Conc_Hosp, Conc_Police, Conc_Bank
  ) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  rename(
    MPI  = MPI_perc,    HHS  = Hhsize,        RUR  = Rural_perc,
    FEM  = Female_pop,  POP  = Pop_district,   LAND = Landsize,
    NJ   = Num_JHS,     NH   = Num_Hosp,       NP   = Num_Police,
    NB   = Num_Bank,    DJ   = Dist_JHS,       DH   = Dist_Hospitals,
    DP   = Dist_Police, DB   = Dist_Banking,
    CJ   = Conc_JHS,    CH   = Conc_Hosp,
    CP   = Conc_Police, CB   = Conc_Bank
  )

# Variable reference table
var_ref <- data.frame(
  Short = c(
    "MPI",
    "HHS","RUR","FEM","POP","LAND",
    "NJ","NH","NP","NB",
    "DJ","DH","DP","DB",
    "CJ","CH","CP","CB"
  ),
  Domain = c(
    "Target",
    rep("Background",    5),
    rep("Availability",  4),
    rep("Proximity",     4),
    rep("Concentration", 4)
  ),
  Description = c(
    "Multidimensional Poverty Index (%)",
    "Average household size",
    "Rural population share (%)",
    "Female population count",
    "Total district population",
    "District land area (km2)",
    "Number of junior high schools",
    "Number of hospitals",
    "Number of police stations",
    "Number of banks",
    "Mean distance to nearest JHS (km)",
    "Mean distance to nearest hospital (km)",
    "Mean distance to nearest police station (km)",
    "Mean distance to nearest bank (km)",
    "Concentration of JHS per population/area",
    "Concentration of hospitals per population/area",
    "Concentration of police stations per population/area",
    "Concentration of banks per population/area"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("Observations:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Variables   :", ncol(df), "\n")
cat("Any NA      :", anyNA(df), "\n")
```

```{r discretization, echo=FALSE}
# Convert all 18 continuous variables to 3-level categorical factors
# Using tertile-based equal-frequency binning
# Handles tied values by jittering when cutpoints collapse

discretize_tertile <- function(x, var_name = ""){
  
  cutpoints <- quantile(x, probs = c(0, 0.333, 0.667, 1),
                        na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # Check for non-unique cutpoints (caused by ties in the data)
  if(length(unique(cutpoints)) < 4){
    
    cat("WARNING: Non-unique cutpoints in",
        var_name, "— applying jittered tertile\n")
    
    # Add tiny random noise to break ties
    # Magnitude: 0.0001 of the variable's standard deviation
    jitter_amount <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.0001
    x_jittered    <- x + runif(length(x),
                                -jitter_amount,
                                 jitter_amount)
    
    cutpoints <- quantile(x_jittered,
                          probs = c(0, 0.333, 0.667, 1),
                          na.rm = TRUE)
    x <- x_jittered
  }
  
  factor_x <- cut(
    x,
    breaks         = cutpoints,
    labels         = c("Low","Medium","High"),
    include.lowest = TRUE,
    ordered_result = TRUE
  )
  
  return(factor_x)
}

# Apply discretization with variable name passed through for warnings
df_disc <- df
for(v in names(df_disc)){
  df_disc[[v]] <- discretize_tertile(df_disc[[v]], var_name = v)
}

df_disc <- as.data.frame(df_disc)

cat("\nDiscretization complete\n")
cat("All factors :", all(sapply(df_disc, is.factor)), "\n")
cat("All 3 levels:",
    all(sapply(df_disc, nlevels) == 3), "\n")
cat("Observations:", nrow(df_disc), "\n")
```

```{r category_distribution, echo=FALSE}
# Show the count of districts in each category for each variable
# Should be roughly equal (~87 per category for tertiles)

dist_table <- sapply(df_disc, table) %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame()

dist_table$Variable <- rownames(dist_table)
dist_table <- dist_table %>%
  select(Variable, Low, Medium, High) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = Low + Medium + High,
    Balance = round(min(c(Low, Medium, High)) /
                     max(c(Low, Medium, High)), 2)
  )

# Compute balance per row
dist_table$Balance <- apply(dist_table[, c("Low","Medium","High")],
                             1,
                             function(x) round(min(x) / max(x), 2))

kable(
  dist_table,
  caption   = "Table 2: Tertile Category Distribution by Variable",
  col.names = c("Variable","Low","Medium","High","Total","Balance"),
  align     = c("l","r","r","r","r","r")
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed","bordered"),
    font_size         = 12,
    full_width        = FALSE
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    which(dist_table$Balance < 0.7),
    background = "#FCEBEB"
  )

cat("\nBalance values close to 1.0 indicate equal frequency across categories.\n")
cat("Values below 0.7 (highlighted red) suggest imbalanced bins,\n")
cat("which can occur when many districts share identical values.\n")
```

```{r descriptive_statistics, echo=FALSE}
# Descriptive statistics combining raw variable stats
# with discretized tertile proportions
# Matches the format: Short Form | Description | Mean | SD |
#                     Tertile 1 | Tertile 2 | Tertile 3

# Raw variable statistics from original continuous data
raw_stats <- data.frame(
  Short = names(df),
  Mean  = round(sapply(df, mean, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
  SD    = round(sapply(df, sd,   na.rm = TRUE), 3)
)

# Discretized proportions from df_disc
# Tertile 1 = Low, Tertile 2 = Medium, Tertile 3 = High
disc_props <- data.frame(
  Short     = names(df_disc),
  Tertile_1 = round(sapply(df_disc,
    function(x) sum(x == "Low",    na.rm = TRUE) / length(x)), 3),
  Tertile_2 = round(sapply(df_disc,
    function(x) sum(x == "Medium", na.rm = TRUE) / length(x)), 3),
  Tertile_3 = round(sapply(df_disc,
    function(x) sum(x == "High",   na.rm = TRUE) / length(x)), 3)
)

# Merge with variable reference for descriptions
desc_table <- var_ref %>%
  left_join(raw_stats,  by = "Short") %>%
  left_join(disc_props, by = "Short") %>%
  select(Short, Description, Mean, SD,
         Tertile_1, Tertile_2, Tertile_3)
```

```{r bn_data_prep, echo=FALSE}
# bnlearn requires a clean data.frame of factors
bn_data_disc <- as.data.frame(df_disc)

# Verify all columns are ordered factors with 3 levels
stopifnot(all(sapply(bn_data_disc, is.factor)))
stopifnot(all(sapply(bn_data_disc, nlevels) == 3))

# Define variable groups by domain
bg_vars   <- c("HHS","RUR","FEM","POP","LAND")
av_vars   <- c("NJ","NH","NP","NB")
prox_vars <- c("DJ","DH","DP","DB")
conc_vars <- c("CJ","CH","CP","CB")
target    <- "MPI"
all_vars  <- names(bn_data_disc)

cat("Discrete BN data ready\n")
cat("Observations:", nrow(bn_data_disc), "\n")
cat("Variables   :", ncol(bn_data_disc), "\n")
cat("Each variable has 3 levels: Low, Medium, High\n")
```

```{r blacklists, echo=FALSE}
# Two blacklist versions for parallel analysis
# Version A: same theoretical constraints as continuous BN
# Version B: minimal — only MPI is forced terminal

# === VERSION A — CONSTRAINED ===
# Rule 1: MPI cannot cause any predictor (terminal target)
bl_A1 <- data.frame(
  from = target,
  to   = setdiff(all_vars, target)
)

# Rule 2: Background variables are root nodes
bl_A2 <- expand.grid(
  from = setdiff(all_vars, bg_vars),
  to   = bg_vars,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Rule 3: Concentration cannot reverse-cause availability
bl_A3 <- data.frame(
  from = c("CB","CH","CP","CJ"),
  to   = c("NB","NH","NP","NJ")
)

blacklist_A <- bind_rows(bl_A1, bl_A2, bl_A3) %>%
  distinct(from, to)

# === VERSION B — UNCONSTRAINED ===
# Only Rule 1 — MPI is terminal
blacklist_B <- bl_A1

cat("Constrained blacklist (Version A) :",
    nrow(blacklist_A), "arcs\n")
cat("Unconstrained blacklist (Version B):",
    nrow(blacklist_B), "arcs\n")
```

```{r structure_learning, echo=FALSE, cache=TRUE}
# For each blacklist version run three algorithms
# HC-BDe — Hill Climbing with Bayesian Dirichlet equivalent score
# MMHC   — hybrid score+constraint based
# PC     — constraint-based
# All use BDe as score where applicable
# 
# BDe is the discrete analog of BGe with Dirichlet priors

# === VERSION A: CONSTRAINED ===
hc_A <- hc(
  bn_data_disc,
  score     = "bde",
  iss       = 1,
  blacklist = blacklist_A
)

mmhc_A <- mmhc(
  bn_data_disc,
  blacklist = blacklist_A
)

pc_A <- pc.stable(
  bn_data_disc,
  alpha     = 0.05,
  blacklist = blacklist_A
)

cat("=== VERSION A (Constrained) ===\n")
cat("HC arcs  :", nrow(arcs(hc_A)),  "\n")
cat("MMHC arcs:", nrow(arcs(mmhc_A)),"\n")
cat("PC arcs  :", nrow(arcs(pc_A)),  "\n")

# === VERSION B: UNCONSTRAINED ===
hc_B <- hc(
  bn_data_disc,
  score     = "bde",
  iss       = 1,
  blacklist = blacklist_B
)

mmhc_B <- mmhc(
  bn_data_disc,
  blacklist = blacklist_B
)

pc_B <- pc.stable(
  bn_data_disc,
  alpha     = 0.05,
  blacklist = blacklist_B
)

cat("\n=== VERSION B (Unconstrained) ===\n")
cat("HC arcs  :", nrow(arcs(hc_B)),  "\n")
cat("MMHC arcs:", nrow(arcs(mmhc_B)),"\n")
cat("PC arcs  :", nrow(arcs(pc_B)),  "\n")
```

```{r bootstrap_both, echo=FALSE}
# Bootstrap arc strength for each blacklist version
# 500 iterations balances precision and computation
# Saves to disk for instant loading on subsequent knits

if(file.exists("boot_disc_A.rds") &
   file.exists("boot_disc_B.rds")){
  
  cat("Loading cached bootstrap results...\n")
  boot_disc_A_hc   <- readRDS("boot_disc_A.rds")$hc
  boot_disc_A_mmhc <- readRDS("boot_disc_A.rds")$mmhc
  boot_disc_A_pc   <- readRDS("boot_disc_A.rds")$pc
  boot_disc_B_hc   <- readRDS("boot_disc_B.rds")$hc
  boot_disc_B_mmhc <- readRDS("boot_disc_B.rds")$mmhc
  boot_disc_B_pc   <- readRDS("boot_disc_B.rds")$pc
  
} else {
  
  # === VERSION A bootstraps ===
  cat("Running Version A — HC bootstrap (500)...\n")
  boot_disc_A_hc <- boot.strength(
    data           = bn_data_disc,
    R              = 500,
    algorithm      = "hc",
    algorithm.args = list(score = "bde",
                           iss   = 1,
                           blacklist = blacklist_A)
  )
  
  cat("Running Version A — MMHC bootstrap (500)...\n")
  boot_disc_A_mmhc <- boot.strength(
    data           = bn_data_disc,
    R              = 500,
    algorithm      = "mmhc",
    algorithm.args = list(blacklist = blacklist_A)
  )
  
  cat("Running Version A — PC bootstrap (500)...\n")
  boot_disc_A_pc <- boot.strength(
    data           = bn_data_disc,
    R              = 500,
    algorithm      = "pc.stable",
    algorithm.args = list(alpha = 0.05,
                           blacklist = blacklist_A)
  )
  
  saveRDS(list(hc   = boot_disc_A_hc,
                mmhc = boot_disc_A_mmhc,
                pc   = boot_disc_A_pc),
          "boot_disc_A.rds")
  
  # === VERSION B bootstraps ===
  cat("Running Version B — HC bootstrap (500)...\n")
  boot_disc_B_hc <- boot.strength(
    data           = bn_data_disc,
    R              = 500,
    algorithm      = "hc",
    algorithm.args = list(score = "bde",
                           iss   = 1,
                           blacklist = blacklist_B)
  )
  
  cat("Running Version B — MMHC bootstrap (500)...\n")
  boot_disc_B_mmhc <- boot.strength(
    data           = bn_data_disc,
    R              = 500,
    algorithm      = "mmhc",
    algorithm.args = list(blacklist = blacklist_B)
  )
  
  cat("Running Version B — PC bootstrap (500)...\n")
  boot_disc_B_pc <- boot.strength(
    data           = bn_data_disc,
    R              = 500,
    algorithm      = "pc.stable",
    algorithm.args = list(alpha = 0.05,
                           blacklist = blacklist_B)
  )
  
  saveRDS(list(hc   = boot_disc_B_hc,
                mmhc = boot_disc_B_mmhc,
                pc   = boot_disc_B_pc),
          "boot_disc_B.rds")
  
  cat("\nAll bootstraps complete and saved\n")
}
```

```{r consensus_dags_both, echo=FALSE}
# Build consensus DAG for each version
# Use threshold 0.50 to match the continuous BN primary model

build_consensus <- function(boot_hc, boot_mmhc, boot_pc,
                              threshold = 0.50){
  
  merged <- boot_hc %>%
    rename(str_hc = strength, dir_hc = direction) %>%
    full_join(
      boot_mmhc %>% rename(str_mmhc = strength,
                           dir_mmhc = direction),
      by = c("from","to")
    ) %>%
    full_join(
      boot_pc %>% rename(str_pc = strength,
                         dir_pc = direction),
      by = c("from","to")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      across(starts_with("str_"), ~ replace_na(., 0)),
      mean_strength = (str_hc + str_mmhc + str_pc) / 3,
      mean_direction = (replace_na(dir_hc,   0) +
                        replace_na(dir_mmhc, 0) +
                        replace_na(dir_pc,   0)) / 3
    ) %>%
    filter(mean_strength >= threshold,
           mean_direction >= 0.50) %>%
    arrange(desc(mean_strength))
  
  return(merged)
}

# Build for both versions
cons_A_arcs <- build_consensus(boot_disc_A_hc,
                                 boot_disc_A_mmhc,
                                 boot_disc_A_pc,
                                 threshold = 0.50)

cons_B_arcs <- build_consensus(boot_disc_B_hc,
                                 boot_disc_B_mmhc,
                                 boot_disc_B_pc,
                                 threshold = 0.50)

# Construct DAG objects
consensus_A <- empty.graph(nodes = all_vars)
arcs(consensus_A) <- as.matrix(cons_A_arcs[, c("from","to")])

consensus_B <- empty.graph(nodes = all_vars)
arcs(consensus_B) <- as.matrix(cons_B_arcs[, c("from","to")])

cat("=== CONSENSUS DAG (Version A — Constrained) ===\n")
cat("Total arcs            :", nrow(arcs(consensus_A)), "\n")
cat("Direct parents of MPI :",
    paste(parents(consensus_A, "MPI"), collapse = ", "), "\n")

cat("\n=== CONSENSUS DAG (Version B — Unconstrained) ===\n")
cat("Total arcs            :", nrow(arcs(consensus_B)), "\n")
cat("Direct parents of MPI :",
    paste(parents(consensus_B, "MPI"), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r visualize_both_dags, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=8}
# Plot both consensus DAGs for visual comparison
# Domain colour coding maintained from continuous BN

plot_dag <- function(dag, title){
  
  g <- as.graphNEL(dag)
  
  fill_colours <- rep("#FFFFFF", length(nodes(dag)))
  names(fill_colours) <- nodes(dag)
  fill_colours[target]    <- "#FCEBEB"
  fill_colours[bg_vars]   <- "#FAEEDA"
  fill_colours[av_vars]   <- "#E1F5EE"
  fill_colours[prox_vars] <- "#EEEDFE"
  fill_colours[conc_vars] <- "#FAECE7"
  
  nAttrs           <- list()
  nAttrs$fillcolor <- fill_colours
  
  plot(g,
       attrs = list(
         node  = list(shape = "rectangle", fontsize = 10,
                      width = 1.2, height = 0.5),
         edge  = list(arrowsize = 0.7),
         graph = list(rankdir = "BT")
       ),
       nodeAttrs = nAttrs,
       main      = title)
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))

plot_dag(consensus_A,
         "Version A: Constrained (Theory-Informed)")

plot_dag(consensus_B,
         "Version B: Unconstrained (Data-Driven)")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# Legend
plot.new()
legend("center",
       legend = c("MPI (Target)","Background",
                  "Availability","Proximity","Concentration"),
       fill   = c("#FCEBEB","#FAEEDA",
                  "#E1F5EE","#EEEDFE","#FAECE7"),
       border = "gray40", bty = "n", cex = 1.0,
       title  = "Node Domain")
```

```{r bde_comparison, echo=FALSE}
# Compare BDe scores across all candidate models
# Higher BDe = better fit
# cextend forces full orientation before scoring

# Force directed orientations
hc_A_d   <- cextend(hc_A)
mmhc_A_d <- cextend(mmhc_A)
pc_A_d   <- cextend(pc_A)
cons_A_d <- cextend(consensus_A)

hc_B_d   <- cextend(hc_B)
mmhc_B_d <- cextend(mmhc_B)
pc_B_d   <- cextend(pc_B)
cons_B_d <- cextend(consensus_B)

bde_scores <- data.frame(
  Version = c(rep("A (Constrained)", 4),
              rep("B (Unconstrained)", 4)),
  Model = c(
    "Hill Climbing (BDe)",
    "MMHC",
    "PC-Stable",
    "Consensus DAG (0.50)",
    "Hill Climbing (BDe)",
    "MMHC",
    "PC-Stable",
    "Consensus DAG (0.50)"
  ),
  BDe_Score = round(c(
    score(hc_A_d,   bn_data_disc, type = "bde", iss = 1),
    score(mmhc_A_d, bn_data_disc, type = "bde", iss = 1),
    score(pc_A_d,   bn_data_disc, type = "bde", iss = 1),
    score(cons_A_d, bn_data_disc, type = "bde", iss = 1),
    score(hc_B_d,   bn_data_disc, type = "bde", iss = 1),
    score(mmhc_B_d, bn_data_disc, type = "bde", iss = 1),
    score(pc_B_d,   bn_data_disc, type = "bde", iss = 1),
    score(cons_B_d, bn_data_disc, type = "bde", iss = 1)
  ), 3),
  N_Arcs = c(
    nrow(arcs(hc_A_d)),   nrow(arcs(mmhc_A_d)),
    nrow(arcs(pc_A_d)),   nrow(arcs(cons_A_d)),
    nrow(arcs(hc_B_d)),   nrow(arcs(mmhc_B_d)),
    nrow(arcs(pc_B_d)),   nrow(arcs(cons_B_d))
  )
)

bde_scores$Best <- ifelse(
  bde_scores$BDe_Score == max(bde_scores$BDe_Score),
  "Yes", ""
)

kable(
  bde_scores,
  caption   = "Table 4: BDe Score Comparison Across All Models",
  col.names = c("Version","Model","BDe Score","No. Arcs","Best Fit")
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed","bordered"),
    font_size         = 12,
    full_width        = FALSE
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    which(bde_scores$Best == "Yes"),
    bold       = TRUE,
    background = "#E1F5EE"
  )
```

```{r model_designation, echo=FALSE}
# Designate Version A (Constrained) as the primary discrete BN
# Version B (Unconstrained) becomes the robustness check

primary_dag_disc        <- consensus_A
sensitivity_dag_disc    <- consensus_B

primary_parents_disc    <- parents(primary_dag_disc, "MPI")
sensitivity_parents_disc <- parents(sensitivity_dag_disc, "MPI")

cat("=== PRIMARY MODEL ===\n")

cat("Direct parents of MPI :",
    paste(primary_parents_disc, collapse = ", "), "\n")

cat("\n=== ROBUSTNESS CHECK ===\n")
cat("DAG: Version B (Unconstrained)\n")
cat("Total arcs            :", nrow(arcs(sensitivity_dag_disc)), "\n")
cat("Direct parents of MPI :",
    paste(sensitivity_parents_disc, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r bayesian_parameter_estimation, echo=FALSE}
# Force full DAG orientation before parameter estimation
# cextend() resolves any partially directed arcs using
# the Dor & Tarsi (1992) extension algorithm

primary_dag_disc_d <- cextend(primary_dag_disc)

cat("Primary DAG arcs before extend:",
    nrow(arcs(primary_dag_disc)), "\n")
cat("Primary DAG arcs after extend :",
    nrow(arcs(primary_dag_disc_d)), "\n")

# Update primary parents — orientation may have changed
primary_parents_disc <- parents(primary_dag_disc_d, "MPI")
cat("Direct parents of MPI:",
    paste(primary_parents_disc, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

# Bayesian parameter estimation with weak prior
# iss = 1 — data dominates the posterior
bn_fit_weak <- bn.fit(
  primary_dag_disc_d,
  data   = bn_data_disc,
  method = "bayes",
  iss    = 1
)

# Bayesian parameter estimation with strong prior
# iss = 10 — moderate regularisation
bn_fit_strong <- bn.fit(
  primary_dag_disc_d,
  data   = bn_data_disc,
  method = "bayes",
  iss    = 10
)

cat("Bayesian parameter estimation complete\n")
cat("Method: Closed-form Dirichlet-Multinomial conjugate update\n")
cat("Weak prior   : iss = 1\n")
cat("Strong prior : iss = 10\n")
cat("Nodes fitted :", length(nodes(primary_dag_disc_d)), "\n")
```

```{r cpt_heatmap, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
# Visualise MPI CPT as heatmap
# Each row is a parent state combination
# Each column is an MPI state (Low/Medium/High)
# Cell colour shows probability

# Reshape CPT for plotting
plot_cpt_heatmap <- function(cpt_df, title){
  
  parent_cols <- setdiff(names(cpt_df),
                          c("MPI_State","Probability","Prior"))
  
  # Create combined parent label
  cpt_df$ParentCombo <- apply(
    cpt_df[, parent_cols, drop = FALSE], 1,
    function(x) paste(parent_cols, x, sep = "=", collapse = " | ")
  )
  
  ggplot(cpt_df,
         aes(x = MPI_State, y = ParentCombo, fill = Probability)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Probability)),
              size = 3.2) +
    scale_fill_gradient(
      low  = "#F7F4ED",
      high = "#185FA5",
      limits = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x     = "MPI State",
      y     = "Parent Configuration"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      axis.text.y      = element_text(size = 8),
      panel.grid       = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r cpt_sensitivity, echo=FALSE}
# Compare CPT entries under weak vs strong priors
# Convergence: |Diff| < 0.05 means data dominates
# Divergence: |Diff| >= 0.05 means prior matters

# Combine both CPTs
cpt_compare <- cpt_weak_df %>%
  rename(Prob_Weak = Probability) %>%
  select(-Prior) %>%
  left_join(
    cpt_strong_df %>%
      rename(Prob_Strong = Probability) %>%
      select(-Prior),
    by = c(setdiff(names(cpt_weak_df), c("Probability","Prior")))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    AbsDiff = round(abs(Prob_Weak - Prob_Strong), 4),
    Verdict = ifelse(AbsDiff < 0.05, "Converge", "Diverge")

# Summary statistics

n_converge <- sum(cpt_compare$Verdict == "Converge")
n_diverge  <- sum(cpt_compare$Verdict == "Diverge")
mean_diff  <- round(mean(cpt_compare$AbsDiff), 4)

cat("Diverge  (Diff >= 0.05)     :", n_diverge,  "\n")
cat("Mean absolute difference    :", mean_diff,  "\n")
cat("Max absolute difference     :", max_diff,   "\n")

  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed","bordered"),
```

```{r query_helper, echo=FALSE}
# Generic function to compute P(MPI = state | evidence)
# Uses likelihood weighting via cpquery for discrete BN
# 
# bnlearn requires evidence as an unquoted expression evaluated
# in its own scope — we use str2lang and pass via list
# This is the correct pattern documented in bnlearn vignettes

query_mpi <- function(bn, evidence_string, n_sim = 50000){
  
  # Convert string to language object
  ev_expr <- str2lang(evidence_string)
  
  # cpquery uses non-standard evaluation — we must construct
  # the call manually with the evidence expression substituted
  
  p_low <- eval(bquote(
    cpquery(.(bn),
            event    = (MPI == "Low"),
            evidence = .(ev_expr),
            n        = .(n_sim))
  ))
  
  p_med <- eval(bquote(
    cpquery(.(bn),
            event    = (MPI == "Medium"),
            evidence = .(ev_expr),
            n        = .(n_sim))
  ))
  
  p_high <- eval(bquote(
    cpquery(.(bn),
            event    = (MPI == "High"),
            evidence = .(ev_expr),
            n        = .(n_sim))
  ))
  
  return(data.frame(
    P_Low    = round(p_low,  4),
    P_Medium = round(p_med,  4),
    P_High   = round(p_high, 4)
  ))
}

# Test the function
test_result <- query_mpi(bn_fit_weak, "(HHS == 'High')")
cat("Test query: P(MPI | HHS = High)\n")
print(test_result)
```

```{r single_var_effects, echo=FALSE}
# For each variable compute P(MPI = state | variable = level)
# Three rows per variable: Low, Medium, High
# Comparing across rows shows the variable's effect on MPI

# Only include variables that appear in the primary DAG
vars_in_dag <- nodes(primary_dag_disc_d)
vars_in_dag <- setdiff(vars_in_dag, "MPI")

effects_list <- list()

set.seed(42)

for(v in vars_in_dag){
  for(state in c("Low","Medium","High")){
    
    evidence_str <- sprintf("(%s == '%s')", v, state)
    
    probs <- tryCatch(
      query_mpi(bn_fit_weak, evidence_str, n_sim = 30000),
      error = function(e) data.frame(P_Low = NA,
                                      P_Medium = NA,
                                      P_High = NA)
    )
    
    effects_list[[length(effects_list) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      Variable = v,
      State    = state,
      probs
    )
  }
}

single_effects <- bind_rows(effects_list)

# Compute change in P(MPI = High) from Low to High state
# This is the simplest measure of total effect
shift_summary <- single_effects %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = State,
    values_from = c(P_Low, P_Medium, P_High),
    names_glue  = "{.value}_{State}"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Shift_PHigh   = round(P_High_High - P_High_Low,    4),
    Shift_PLow    = round(P_Low_High  - P_Low_Low,     4),
    Effect_Direction = case_when(
      Shift_PHigh > 0.10  ~ "Strong increases poverty",
      Shift_PHigh > 0.05  ~ "Moderate increases poverty",
      Shift_PHigh < -0.10 ~ "Strong reduces poverty",
      Shift_PHigh < -0.05 ~ "Moderate reduces poverty",
      TRUE                ~ "Negligible / no effect"
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Variable, P_High_Low, P_High_High,
         Shift_PHigh, Effect_Direction) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Shift_PHigh)))

kable(
  shift_summary,
  caption   = "Table 7: Counterfactual Total Effect on P(MPI = High)",
  col.names = c("Variable",
                "P(MPI=High | Var=Low)",
                "P(MPI=High | Var=High)",
                "Probability Shift",
                "Effect Direction")
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed","bordered"),
    font_size         = 12,
    full_width        = FALSE
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    which(shift_summary$Effect_Direction == "Strong increases poverty"),
    bold = TRUE, background = "#FCEBEB"
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    which(shift_summary$Effect_Direction == "Strong reduces poverty"),
    bold = TRUE, background = "#E1F5EE"
  )
```

```{r effect_classification, echo=FALSE}
# Classify each variable's effect on MPI as Direct, Indirect, or None
# Direct  — variable is a parent of MPI
# Indirect — variable has at least one path to MPI but not direct
# None — no path to MPI in the DAG

# Find paths from each variable to MPI
find_paths_to_mpi <- function(dag, from_node, visited = c()){
  if(from_node == "MPI") return(list(c(from_node)))
  visited <- c(visited, from_node)
  child_nodes <- children(dag, from_node)
  if(length(child_nodes) == 0) return(list())
  
  all_paths <- list()
  for(child in child_nodes){
    if(child %in% visited) next
    sub_paths <- find_paths_to_mpi(dag, child, visited)
    for(sp in sub_paths){
      all_paths <- c(all_paths, list(c(from_node, sp)))
    }
  }
  return(all_paths)
}

# Direct parents of MPI
direct_parents <- parents(primary_dag_disc_d, "MPI")

# Classify each variable
classification <- shift_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Has_Direct_Arc = Variable %in% direct_parents,
    N_Paths = sapply(Variable, function(v){
      length(find_paths_to_mpi(primary_dag_disc_d, v))
    }),
    Effect_Type = case_when(
      Has_Direct_Arc          ~ "Direct",
      !Has_Direct_Arc & N_Paths > 0 ~ "Indirect only",
      TRUE                    ~ "No effect (no path)"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Shift_PHigh)))

kable(
  classification %>%
    select(Variable, Effect_Type, N_Paths,
           Shift_PHigh, Effect_Direction),
  caption   = "Table 8: Direct vs Indirect Effect Classification",
  col.names = c("Variable","Effect Type","Paths to MPI",
                "Probability Shift","Direction")
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed","bordered"),
    font_size         = 12,
    full_width        = FALSE
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    which(classification$Effect_Type == "Direct"),
    bold = TRUE, background = "#E1F5EE"
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    which(classification$Effect_Type == "No effect (no path)"),
    background = "#FCEBEB"
  )
```

```{r policy_scenarios, echo=FALSE}
# Run policy-relevant counterfactual scenarios

# Reports the resulting P(MPI = state) distribution

set.seed(42)

scenarios <- list(
  list(
    label    = "Baseline (no evidence)",
    evidence = "TRUE"
  ),
  list(
    label    = "Worst case: high HHS, high RUR",
    evidence = "(HHS == 'High') & (RUR == 'High')"
  ),
  list(
    label    = "Best case: low HHS, low RUR",
    evidence = "(HHS == 'Low') & (RUR == 'Low')"
  ),
  list(
    label    = "Smaller households only (HHS=Low)",
    evidence = "(HHS == 'Low')"
  ),
  list(
    label    = "Urbanisation only (RUR=Low)",
    evidence = "(RUR == 'Low')"
  ),
  list(
    label    = "Both household + urban policy",
    evidence = "(HHS == 'Low') & (RUR == 'Low')"
  ),
  list(
    label    = "Education policy: high NJ alone",
    evidence = "(NJ == 'High')"
  ),
  list(
    label    = "Combined demographic-education",
    evidence = "(HHS == 'Low') & (RUR == 'Low') & (NJ == 'High')"
  )
)

scenario_results <- lapply(scenarios, function(s){

  caption   = "Table 9: Counterfactual MPI Distributions Under Policy Scenarios",

  )
```

```{r scenario_sensitivity, echo=FALSE}
# Verify scenarios are robust to prior choice
# Compare weak vs strong prior for each scenario

set.seed(42)

scenario_results_strong <- lapply(scenarios, function(s){
  result <- query_mpi(bn_fit_strong, s$evidence, n_sim = 50000)
  cbind(Scenario = s$label, result)
})

scenario_strong_df <- bind_rows(scenario_results_strong)

scenario_compare <- scenario_df %>%
  select(Scenario, P_Low_Weak = P_Low,
         P_Med_Weak = P_Medium, P_High_Weak = P_High) %>%
  left_join(
    scenario_strong_df %>%
      select(Scenario, P_Low_Strong = P_Low,
             P_Med_Strong = P_Medium, P_High_Strong = P_High),
    by = "Scenario"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    MaxDiff = pmax(
      abs(P_Low_Weak  - P_Low_Strong),
      abs(P_Med_Weak  - P_Med_Strong),
      abs(P_High_Weak - P_High_Strong)
    ),
    Verdict = ifelse(MaxDiff < 0.05, "Robust", "Sensitive")
  )

kable(
  scenario_compare %>%
    select(Scenario, P_High_Weak, P_High_Strong,
           MaxDiff, Verdict),
  caption   = "Table 10: Scenario Robustness — Weak vs Strong Prior",
  col.names = c("Scenario","P(High|Weak)",
                "P(High|Strong)","Max Diff","Verdict"),
  digits    = 4
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed","bordered"),
    font_size         = 12,
    full_width        = FALSE
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    which(scenario_compare$Verdict == "Robust"),
    background = "#E1F5EE"
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    which(scenario_compare$Verdict == "Sensitive"),
```

```{r appendix_full_effects, echo=FALSE}
# Appendix Table A1 — Full Direct vs Indirect Effect Classification
# Self-contained: redefines all required objects locally
# so it does not depend on Phase D4 objects being in session

# All predictor variables (everything except MPI)
non_target_vars_app <- setdiff(all_vars, "MPI")

# Direct parents of MPI in the primary DAG
direct_parents_app <- parents(primary_dag_disc_d, "MPI")

# Reuse find_paths_to_mpi function defined in Phase D4
# If session is fresh redefine it here
find_paths_to_mpi <- function(dag, from_node, visited = c()){
  if(from_node == "MPI") return(list(c(from_node)))
  visited <- c(visited, from_node)
  child_nodes <- children(dag, from_node)
  if(length(child_nodes) == 0) return(list())
  all_paths <- list()
  for(child in child_nodes){
    if(child %in% visited) next
    sub_paths <- find_paths_to_mpi(dag, child, visited)
    for(sp in sub_paths){
      all_paths <- c(all_paths, list(c(from_node, sp)))
    }
  }
  return(all_paths)
}

# Recompute single-variable probability shifts
# so the appendix is self-contained
set.seed(42)
app_effects <- list()

for(v in non_target_vars_app){
  
  n_paths <- length(find_paths_to_mpi(primary_dag_disc_d, v))
  
  ev_low  <- str2lang(sprintf("(%s == 'Low')",  v))
  ev_high <- str2lang(sprintf("(%s == 'High')", v))
  
  p_low <- eval(bquote(
    cpquery(bn_fit_weak,
            event    = (MPI == "High"),
            evidence = .(ev_low),
            n        = 30000)
  ))
  
  p_high <- eval(bquote(
    cpquery(bn_fit_weak,
            event    = (MPI == "High"),
            evidence = .(ev_high),
            n        = 30000)
  ))
  
  app_effects[[v]] <- data.frame(
    Variable    = v,
    Effect_Type = case_when(
      v %in% direct_parents_app ~ "Direct",
      n_paths > 0               ~ "Indirect only",
      TRUE                      ~ "No causal path"
    ),
    N_Paths     = n_paths,
    P_High_Low  = round(p_low,         4),
    P_High_High = round(p_high,        4),
    Shift       = round(p_high - p_low, 4)
  )
}

app_df <- bind_rows(app_effects) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(Shift)))

kable(
  app_df,
  caption   = paste(
    "Appendix Table A1: Full Counterfactual Effect Classification",
    "— All 17 Predictors"
  ),
  col.names = c("Variable","Effect Type","Paths to MPI",
                "P(High | Var=Low)","P(High | Var=High)",
                "Probability Shift"),
  digits    = 4
) %>%
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped","hover","condensed","bordered"),
    font_size         = 12,
    full_width        = FALSE
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    which(app_df$Effect_Type == "Direct"),
    bold = TRUE, background = "#E1F5EE"
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    which(app_df$Effect_Type == "Indirect only"),
    background = "#FAEEDA"
  ) %>%
  row_spec(
    which(app_df$Effect_Type == "No causal path"),
    background = "#FCEBEB"
  ) %>%
  footnote(
    general = paste(
      "Green = direct causal effect on MPI.",
      "Yellow = indirect effect through intermediate nodes.",
      "Red = no causal path to MPI;",
      "probability shifts reflect confounded",
      "statistical association, not causal influence."
    ),
    general_title = "Note:"
  )
```

```{r name_matching_diagnostic, echo=FALSE}
# Compare district names between the data (Districtnames column)
# and the shapefile (District column) to catch mismatches
# before any map is built

shapefile_names <- sort(ghana_sf$District)
data_names      <- sort(df_raw$Districtnames)

cat("Districts in shapefile:", length(shapefile_names), "\n")
cat("Districts in data     :", length(data_names), "\n\n")

# Exact matches
exact_match <- intersect(shapefile_names, data_names)
cat("Exact matches:", length(exact_match), "out of", nrow(df_raw), "\n\n")

# Names in data but NOT in shapefile (need fixing)
unmatched_data <- setdiff(data_names, shapefile_names)
cat("=== Districts in DATA with no exact shapefile match (",
    length(unmatched_data), ") ===\n")
print(unmatched_data)

cat("\n")

# Names in shapefile but NOT in data
unmatched_shapefile <- setdiff(shapefile_names, data_names)
cat("=== Districts in SHAPEFILE with no exact data match (",
    length(unmatched_shapefile), ") ===\n")
print(unmatched_shapefile)

# Simple fuzzy suggestion: for each unmatched data name, find the closest
# shapefile name by string distance, to help manual reconciliation
if(length(unmatched_data) > 0){
  cat("\n=== Suggested closest shapefile match for each unmatched data name ===\n")
  for(nm in unmatched_data){
    dists <- adist(nm, shapefile_names)[1, ]
    best  <- shapefile_names[which.min(dists)]
    cat(sprintf("  DATA: '%s'  ->  CLOSEST SHAPEFILE: '%s' (distance = %d)\n",
                nm, best, min(dists)))
  }
}
```

```{r name_reconciliation, echo=FALSE}
# Manual reconciliation table
# Two mismatches identified by the diagnostic chunk:
# 1. Data has the correct "Cape Coast" but shapefile has a typo "Cape Cape"
# 2. Data has a truncated "STM" but shapefile has the full "STMA"

name_fixes <- data.frame(
  data_name      = c(
    "Cape Coast Metropolitan Area (CCMA)",
    "Sekondi Takoradi Metropolitan Area (STM"
  ),
  shapefile_name = c(
    "Cape Cape Metropolitan Area (CCMA)",
    "Sekondi Takoradi Metropolitan Area (STMA)"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Apply fixes to a working copy of df_raw used only for mapping
df_map <- df_raw

for(i in seq_len(nrow(name_fixes))){
  df_map$Districtnames[df_map$Districtnames == name_fixes$data_name[i]] <-
    name_fixes$shapefile_name[i]
}

# Re-verify match rate after fixes
post_fix_match <- sum(df_map$Districtnames %in% ghana_sf$District)
cat("Districts matched after reconciliation:", post_fix_match,
    "out of", nrow(df_map), "\n")

if(post_fix_match < nrow(df_map)){
  cat("\nStill unmatched:\n")
  print(df_map$Districtnames[!df_map$Districtnames %in% ghana_sf$District])
}
```





```{r service_count_maps_NO_LABEL, echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=10}
# Choropleth maps of raw counts for the four availability variables
# NJ = junior high schools, NH = hospitals,
# NP = police stations, NB = banks

# Join the raw count data to the shapefile by district name
map_data <- ghana_sf %>%
  left_join(
    df_map %>% select(Districtnames, Num_JHS, Num_Hosp,
                       Num_Police, Num_Bank),
    by = c("District" = "Districtnames")
  )

cat("Districts with joined data:",
    sum(!is.na(map_data$Num_JHS)), "out of", nrow(map_data), "\n")

# Reusable plotting function for one count variable
plot_count_map <- function(data, var, title, fill_label){
  ggplot(data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[var]]), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c("#FAEEDA", "#E1A95F", "#A6432F", "#5C1A1A"),
      na.value = "grey85",
      name = fill_label
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

p_nj <- plot_count_map(map_data, "Num_JHS",
                        "Number of Junior High Schools", "Count")
p_nh <- plot_count_map(map_data, "Num_Hosp",
                        "Number of Hospitals", "Count")
p_np <- plot_count_map(map_data, "Num_Police",
                        "Number of Police Stations", "Count")
p_nb <- plot_count_map(map_data, "Num_Bank",
                        "Number of Banks", "Count")

grid.arrange(p_nj, p_nh, p_np, p_nb, ncol = 2,
             top = "Figure: District-Level Counts of Service Facilities (Availability Domain)")
```


```{r service_count_maps_LABELLED, echo=FALSE, fig.width=16, fig.height=14}
# Choropleth maps of raw counts for the four availability variables
# with district name labels at polygon centroids

map_data <- ghana_sf %>%
  left_join(
    df_map %>% select(Districtnames, Num_JHS, Num_Hosp,
                       Num_Police, Num_Bank),
    by = c("District" = "Districtnames")
  )

cat("Districts with joined data:",
    sum(!is.na(map_data$Num_JHS)), "out of", nrow(map_data), "\n")

# Compute centroids once for label placement
map_data$centroid <- st_centroid(map_data$geometry)
map_data$lon <- st_coordinates(map_data$centroid)[, 1]
map_data$lat <- st_coordinates(map_data$centroid)[, 2]

# Shorten long district names for label readability
# Strips common suffixes so labels do not overlap as badly
map_data$label_short <- map_data$District %>%
  gsub(" Municipal$", "", .) %>%
  gsub(" Metropolitan.*$", "", .) %>%
  gsub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", .)

plot_count_map <- function(data, var, title, fill_label){
  ggplot(data) +
    geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[var]]), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
    geom_text(
      aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = label_short),
      size = 1.4, color = "black", fontface = "plain",
      check_overlap = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(
      colours = c("#FAEEDA", "#E1A95F", "#A6432F", "#5C1A1A"),
      na.value = "grey85",
      name = fill_label
    ) +
    labs(title = title) +
    theme_void(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

p_nj <- plot_count_map(map_data, "Num_JHS",
                        "Number of Junior High Schools", "Count")
p_nh <- plot_count_map(map_data, "Num_Hosp",
                        "Number of Hospitals", "Count")
p_np <- plot_count_map(map_data, "Num_Police",
                        "Number of Police Stations", "Count")
p_nb <- plot_count_map(map_data, "Num_Bank",
                        "Number of Banks", "Count")

grid.arrange(p_nj, p_nh, p_np, p_nb, ncol = 2,
             top = "Figure: District-Level Counts of Service Facilities (Availability Domain)")
```



```{r district_reference_map, echo=FALSE, fig.width=14, fig.height=12}
# Single reference map showing all 261 district names
# Used once as a locator map; subsequent choropleths stay label-free

map_data$centroid <- st_centroid(map_data$geometry)
map_data$lon <- st_coordinates(map_data$centroid)[, 1]
map_data$lat <- st_coordinates(map_data$centroid)[, 2]
map_data$label_short <- map_data$District %>%
  gsub(" Municipal$", "", .) %>%
  gsub(" Metropolitan.*$", "", .) %>%
  gsub(" \\(.*\\)$", "", .)

ggplot(map_data) +
  geom_sf(fill = "#F7F4ED", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.15) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = label_short),
    size = 1.3, color = "black", check_overlap = TRUE
  ) +
  labs(title = "Figure: District Boundaries and Names (n = 261)") +
  theme_void(base_size = 11) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0.5))
```
